method: deterministic FMEA over fault sources, primary shutdown, an electrically separate or fail-safe containment path, retained reason and physical recovery

fault_plane.proof: while SAFETY_FAULT_REQUEST is held low at startup, series-isolated FAULT_ASSERT_SENSE must also read low before the controller may release its request or accept a physical re-arm. High or unreadable proof blocks every lease, holds S3 in fault-only/reset state and requires KILL plus service. The proof is repeated at every physical KILL-to-RUN boundary; no mid-session destructive proof is claimed
fault_plane.destructive_test_boundary: every physical KILL-to-RUN; never silently re-arms during a running session

faults.single_fault: RUN moved to KILL or RUN conductor opens
faults.detection: RUN_EDGE falls
faults.independent_or_fail_safe_path: the second switch throw also requests protected-pack shutdown
faults.safe_result: all TX gates become safe; C5/RP reset; no automatic restart

faults.single_fault: RUN_LOOP_RAW is shorted in the permissive state
faults.detection: operator selects KILL and POWER_COMMAND_OFF_N falls
faults.independent_or_fail_safe_path: pack_admission independently receives the same KILL command
faults.safe_result: the single masking short cannot defeat KILL
faults.recovery: service the switch/harness before physical re-arm

faults.single_fault: FAULT_ASSERT_N pull-up opens
faults.detection: the wired plane falls through the 1-MOhm backup pull-down
faults.independent_or_fail_safe_path: endpoint pull-downs and direct reset sinks remain
faults.safe_result: safe latched shutdown

faults.single_fault: FAULT_ASSERT_N is stuck low
faults.detection: FAULT_ASSERT_SENSE remains low and RUN_PERMIT cannot set
faults.independent_or_fail_safe_path: direct reset and endpoint gates also stay asserted
faults.safe_result: safe no-start
faults.recovery: service is required; software cannot override

faults.single_fault: FAULT_ASSERT_N is stuck at the permissive level before RUN
faults.detection: P11 reads high through 100 kOhm while SAFETY_FAULT_REQUEST is held low
faults.primary_path: the safety controller refuses every lease and re-arm admission
faults.independent_or_fail_safe_path: the sense resistor prevents an expander-pin fault from dominating the plane
faults.safe_result: safe no-admission with S3 held in fault/reset mode
faults.recovery: KILL plus service; the proof repeats at every physical re-arm

faults.single_fault: S3 application or system heartbeat stops
faults.detection: TPS3435 window or safety-controller heartbeat monitor expires
faults.independent_or_fail_safe_path: controller request remains an independent source
faults.safe_result: bounded hard shutdown and retained reason

faults.single_fault: safety-controller firmware hangs
faults.detection: WDI edges stop
faults.independent_or_fail_safe_path: off-safe pulls do not depend on the controller
faults.safe_result: bounded hard shutdown

faults.single_fault: AON voltage browns out or disappears

faults.independent_or_fail_safe_path: reset-gate pull-ups, endpoint pull-downs and eFuse loss behavior are safe
faults.safe_result: immediate safe state; final journal write may be unavailable
faults.recovery: next boot shows the explicit AON-loss fallback

faults.single_fault: RUN_PERMIT latch/output is stuck permissive
faults.detection: latch/output readback mismatch or surviving TX evidence
faults.independent_or_fail_safe_path: direct C5/RP reset, nRF/CC backup gates, voice eFuse clamp and branch gates bypass RUN_PERMIT
faults.safe_result: hazardous endpoints lose command or power

faults.single_fault: one primary C5 or RP reset driver is stuck released
faults.detection: fault assertion plus reset/rail evidence mismatch
faults.independent_or_fail_safe_path: separate FAULT_ASSERT_N open-drain sink reaches the same EN/RUN node
faults.safe_result: processor held reset by the independent sink

faults.single_fault: one direct FAULT_ASSERT_N reset sink is stuck released
faults.detection: fault assertion plus reset/rail evidence mismatch
faults.primary_path: the separate RUN_PERMIT inverter and NMOS path asserts reset
faults.independent_or_fail_safe_path: endpoint gates also remove transmitter power/commands
faults.safe_result: processor and transmitters remain contained

faults.independent_or_fail_safe_path: CE gates and Ioff buffers also default safe
faults.safe_result: all three nRF24 rails/CE paths are contained without losing full-mix capability

faults.single_fault: nRF backup gate is stuck high
faults.detection: startup/fault-injection proof detects the final-enable mismatch
faults.primary_path: the independent RUN_PERMIT-qualified primary gate falls
faults.independent_or_fail_safe_path: CE gates and endpoint pull-down remain
faults.safe_result: nRF group remains off for the single backup-gate fault

faults.single_fault: nRF load switch is shorted on

faults.primary_path: three independent CE gates fall low
faults.independent_or_fail_safe_path: host/return Ioff isolation and lease enforcement remain
faults.safe_result: a switch short alone cannot command TX; actual TX is caught by physical evidence
faults.recovery: KILL and service; no further TX lease

faults.single_fault: primary CC rail gate is stuck high

faults.independent_or_fail_safe_path: the other branch remains isolated and unknown accessories receive no TX lease

faults.safe_result: a rail short alone cannot produce optical TX

faults.independent_or_fail_safe_path: persistent request survives the primary latch-path mismatch

faults.independent_or_fail_safe_path: aggregate ANY_TX_AON_N and front LED do not need software

faults.safe_result: safe no-admission for the affected transmitter
faults.recovery: service before the mode is available

faults.single_fault: one NTC is open or shorted
faults.detection: ADC code is outside the valid thermistor window
faults.independent_or_fail_safe_path: watchdog covers a controller hang
faults.safe_result: all hazardous power/TX is shut down

faults.single_fault: one NTC is plausibly stuck in-range
faults.detection: startup trend/cross-zone plausibility and H8-correlated rate checks
faults.primary_path: unattended admission uses bounded energy/time even with one unavailable zone
faults.independent_or_fail_safe_path: converter/eFuse/chip thermal protections remain
faults.safe_result: the sensor fault alone cannot create heat; the affected high-power profile is blocked

faults.single_fault: one eFuse/load path fails open
faults.detection: PG/current/rail mismatch
faults.independent_or_fail_safe_path: other rails remain protected and no automatic retry is allowed
faults.safe_result: safe loss of function

faults.single_fault: power disappears during journal commit
faults.detection: neither CRC slot has a newer valid commit marker
faults.primary_path: hardware loss behavior is already safe
faults.independent_or_fail_safe_path: next boot selects the last valid slot or explicit power-loss fallback
faults.safe_result: no fabricated cause is shown
faults.recovery: read-only service export, then physical recovery

corrections.finding: a stuck-permissive RUN_PERMIT latch or primary endpoint gate could preserve transmitter power
corrections.correction: separate direct FAULT_ASSERT_N reset sinks, nRF/CC backup gates, voice eFuse clamp, expansion-branch qualification and the shared reset-off IR rail were fitted

corrections.finding: a FAULT_ASSERT_N line stuck permissive was latent before transmitter admission
corrections.correction: unused TCA9535 P11 and its existing resistor position became a 100-kOhm series-isolated startup proof input

corrections.finding: RUN_LOOP_RAW shorted permissive could mask the RUN-side KILL path
corrections.correction: the second SPDT throw now reaches FAULT_ASSERT_N through the already fitted spare SN74LVC3G07 channel as well as requesting pack shutdown

residual_physical_only: H6: physically separate RUN_PERMIT and FAULT_ASSERT_N routing, their local buffers and endpoint gate returns; verify no single via/pad short joins both paths
H8: inject every SF-01..SF-30 case at accessible pads and verify rail fall, no RF/optical output, retained reason and physical-only re-arm
H8: calibrate evidence thresholds and prove stuck-active, stuck-inactive and unreadable evidence behavior for all nine channels
H8: measure watchdog, reset, eFuse, QOD and transmitter-energy deadlines; analytical 0/100/1760-ms classes are upper-level contracts, not measured closure
H8: interrupt every two-slot flash-journal write boundary and verify last-valid-slot or explicit AON-loss fallback
H3.6.3: bound the uninterrupted unattended interval because FAULT_ASSERT_N proof is destructive and therefore occurs at physical re-arm, not continuously
non_claims: two simultaneous independent faults or a first latent safety fault followed by a second hazard
common physical damage that shorts both independent shutdown routes or bypasses a protected rail directly
guaranteed final diagnostic write after complete AON loss
production-safe timing, RF silence or temperature without H6 layout and H8 measured fault injection
